prompt: Why should the booklet include both cooking times?
promptZh: 小冊子為什麼要收錄兩個烹調時間？

options.text: One is the time needed to copy the recipe.
options.zh: 其中一個是抄寫食譜的時間。
options.whyZh: 兩個都是烹調時間，不是抄寫時間。

options.text: They apply to different amounts of the recipe.
options.zh: 兩個時間分別適用不同的食譜份量。
options.whyZh: 二十分鐘對應整盤，十五分鐘對應減半且改用小烤盤的版本。

options.text: The smaller pan takes longer to heat up.
options.whyZh: 對話沒有談預熱時間；小份量反而寫十五分鐘。

options.text: The first batch must cook for twenty minutes and then cook for fifteen more.
options.zh: 第一批須先煮二十分鐘，再加十五分鐘。
options.whyZh: 兩個時間屬不同版本，不能相加。

explanationZh: 二十分鐘對應整盤，十五分鐘對應減半且改用小烤盤的版本。
evidence: That recipe card has two times on it. Grandma wrote twenty minutes in ink, and Dad wrote fifteen in pencil below it. Which one goes into our booklet? / Both, but don’t put them on the same line. Twenty is for a full pan. Dad halved the recipe when he used the smaller pan.

evidenceSpans.speaker: M
